role: full-screen sustained storm (Thousand Petal Requiem, phase-3 entrance)
style: stylized anime combat, glowing additive sakura (Senbonzakura) over a dark night arena, side-view 2D
dominant_shape: screen-filling petal whirlpool round a white eye

beats.name: rise
beats.expect: veil dims the arena, bands fade in

beats.name: hold
beats.expect: petals and blades spiral inward round the eye

beats.name: loop
beats.expect: storm keeps turning with no visible seam

layer_plan.name: 0:Dark veil
layer_plan.role: dark: wine veil that dims the arena

layer_plan.name: 1:Outer band
layer_plan.role: volume: deep-pink band turning round the screen

layer_plan.name: 3:Vortex pivot
layer_plan.role: pivot spinning the storm about Z

layer_plan.name: 3:Vortex pivot/1:Storm blades
layer_plan.role: signature: crescent blades riding the vortex

layer_plan.name: 4:Storm strands
layer_plan.role: shape change: torn strands in the whirl

layer_plan.name: 5:Eye bloom
layer_plan.role: light: pink bloom of the eye

acceptance: The whirl turns visibly (petals travel inward along a spiral)
Characters stay readable through the veil
At most three screen-sized additive layers at once
avoid: The veil going so dark the fighters disappear
